summary: Frontend-only testing of Ratio Quest. Verified Lesson 1 end-to-end up to mastery (goal -> explore -> explain quick checks -> worked example -> guided with misconception feedback for '2:4' (order) and '4:6' (whole) -> independent (build) -> mastery intro -> mastery runner). Also exercised Lesson 2 locking, Lab (plus/minus/compare selectors/zero sentence/new-challenge/board-change clearing), Final locking + 'Save answer' assessment mode, Progress page (reset dialog + reduce-motion switch), Teacher page (answer-key switch + print sheet), Games (zone + mini-game locking by lesson progress), 404 route, deep-link refresh, and mobile (390px) bottom nav with More dropdown containing Progress/Teacher. All critical flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Review refers to 'print-btn' and 'misconception-*' testids but implementation uses 'print-sheet-btn' and 'mis-{code}'. Not a bug, but inconsistency with the test spec provided to future testers; consider aligning testids or updating the spec.
Review refers to 'calm-mode-switch' but implementation uses 'reduce-motion-switch' (label is 'Calm mode'). Same naming inconsistency.

LessonPage uses 'lesson-continue-btn' testid for all step-advancing buttons; worked example has 'worked-next-btn' and 'continue-btn' intra-step. Works correctly, but mixing of generic + specific testids inside the same lesson could be unified.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage key 'ratio-quest-progress-v1' with per-test seed() builders for mastered/not-mastered states to speed access to locked areas (Lab/Final/Games). Lesson 1 was still exercised genuinely end-to-end from goal through guided + mastery intro.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testids on key pages: Teacher print = 'print-sheet-btn'; Teacher misconception accordion items = 'mis-A'...'mis-H' etc. Progress calm/reduce-motion switch = 'reduce-motion-switch'. Final assessment uses 'check-answer-btn' with text 'Save answer'. Mastery automation needs mapping of plural words in the prompt (e.g. 'toy cars', 'toy bikes') back to count-* testids (e.g. 'count-car','count-bike'); naive first-token matching fails for compound plurals. Visited routes with hot reload are stable; deep-link refresh works. Mobile 'mnav-more' DropdownMenu renders Progress/Teacher as separate 'mnav-progress'/'mnav-teacher' link testids.
